_critical_contract: This fixture's MAIN PURPOSE is to test SKR 03 ↔ SKR 04 disambiguation. If the pipeline ever classifies this as skr_03, the entire mapping falls apart (1200 becomes Bank instead of AR, 4000 stops being revenue, etc).

must_flag.rationale: Detection MUST identify this as SKR 04, NOT SKR 03. Discriminators: bank at 1800, revenue at 4000, no 8xxx revenue accounts.
In SKR 04, 1800 is Bank (asset). In SKR 03, 1800 doesn't exist as a primary account and the Bank lives at 1200. Disambiguation must succeed.

must_NOT_flag.rationale: If the detector returns skr_03, account 1200 (AR in SKR 04) would be misread as Bank (SKR 03), and 4000 (Revenue in SKR 04) would not map to revenue. EVERY downstream metric breaks.
SKR 04 has NO 8xxx revenue accounts. If the briefing or mapping references 8400 as a revenue source, detection failed.
In SKR 04, 1200 is Forderungen (AR). Treating it as Bank would attribute €612k to cash that's actually receivables — corrupts every liquidity ratio.
